card.fires_on: Short middle pieces of split-up brand or generic drug names, mostly 'AZ' or 'az' after 'TR' or 'tr' (TRAZIMERA, trazodone). Also fires on similar pieces of software names like LaTeX or PythonWin.

modes.label: Software term pieces
modes.description: A piece inside a computing term, such as LaTeX or a Frame window class.
